test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains a misspelt word.

__Obesity__ is __rapidly__ becoming the __leading__ cause of __prevantable__ deaths in the United States.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"prevantable"** is misspelt and should be correctly written as "**preventable**". (रोकथाम योग्य)

 
 
• **Example: **The flu is a **preventable **disease if you get vaccinated every year.
 
 
 
• **"Preventable"** means something that can be stopped or avoided, especially by taking action in advance. (रोकथाम योग्य)
 
 
• **Example: **Many accidents are** preventable** if drivers follow the traffic rules.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **prevantable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Rapidly **(तेजी से): Happening in a short time or at a fast pace.

 
 
• **Example:** Technology is** rapidly** changing the way we live and work.
 
 
 
• **Leading **(प्रमुख): Most important or most successful.
 
 
• **Example: **She is a **leading** expert in her field of study.
 
 
 
• **Obesity** (मोटापा): The condition of being grossly overweight.
 
 
• **Example: Obesity** can lead to various health problems, including diabetes and heart disease.

The correct answer is **Option 2)**
